main_text.p: alicubi ? Latus & pulcherrimus in procursum campus, si maceriam illam tollas: Quid juvat proplasma praefigere tabulæ, si evagetur generosior penicillus, si imitari dedignetur,& superet propositi speciem ? Euge ! ista colorum temperies, liberalis ille dutus, istud lineamentum tam decens, tam vivax, in hanc aut illam Nympham non quadrant; Summæ sunt ista reservanda Pandoræ: Bonæ mentis adhuc illa labes est, ut Virtutem, quod eam quamplurimis optet esse communem, affingat immeritis: probrum adulationis sibi conscisci incauta Pietas:Nulli formam istam astringe materiæ:Divina est:Exhibe nobis boni Principis Notionem: dic licet in scemate quid egerit: dic justitiam clementiâ,dic potentiam temperasse modestiâ, dic terribilem

page.notes: The text is cut off at the right edge of the scan; the last word of several lines is partly hidden by the facing page, so some line endings are reconstructed from the visible letters. Fragments of the facing page's margin notes (e.g. "QUEST.", "Cur Cæsar", "Machiav.") are show-through or the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Line "tem perasse" and "lem" at the foot are partly obscured.
